reviewer.boundary: The two shuffled passes are repeated applications of one AI-authored deterministic review procedure. They measure repeatability only, not human validation, inter-rater reliability, semantic entailment, practical feasibility, usefulness to students, novelty, or public-corpus validity.

source_first_construction.answerable_cases: Questions and answer points were authored directly from frozen extracted-paper chunks before retrieval execution, without consulting system rankings or answers.
source_first_construction.negative_cases: Six in-domain near-miss questions were authored before retrieval execution from named papers. Each freezes a context locator and exact phrases absent from every frozen chunk of that paper; this structural absence check is not proof of semantic absence under every paraphrase.

corpus_and_projection_boundary.technical_selection_predicate: Paper.corpus_eligibility_status == eligible AND Paper.extraction_generation_id IS NOT NULL AND Paper.chunk_generation_id IS NOT NULL AND Paper.chunk_extraction_generation_id == Paper.extraction_generation_id AND Chunk.extraction_generation_id == Paper.extraction_generation_id

generation_link_reconciliation.validated_chain: exact PDF SHA -> extraction manifest generation and JSON-pages/TXT mirror -> chunk manifest/hash -> exact chunk JSON/DB mirror

corpus_and_projection_boundary.public_projection_predicate_recorded_not: review_status approved AND publication_status published AND rights_status cleared AND public_access_level searchable AND corpus_eligibility_status eligible AND extraction_review_status approved AND extraction_generation_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_generation_id IS NOT NULL AND chunk_extraction_generation_id == extraction_generation_id AND public_index_generation_id == chunk_generation_id AND chunk_count > 0 AND Chunk.extraction_generation_id == Paper.extraction_generation_id
corpus_and_projection_boundary.locator_hash_semantics: source_hash is SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 chunk text; execution also records retrieval_source_identity_v2 effective hashes that include retrieval-affecting paper metadata

temporary_index_preparation.source: the frozen generation-linked technical eligible corpus on a temporary SQLite copy after fail-closed reconciliation

fixed_answerability_rule.minimum_query_coverage: 0.25 when the filtered query has at least four terms; otherwise 0.34

finder.temporary_index_preparation: reuse the same rebuilt temporary keyword index and one paired retrieval response per profile
finder.comparison: paired evidence-only retrieval versus the full finder on the same frozen profile and technical corpus; the second crop constraint variant is reported only as sensitivity evidence and is excluded from the primary held-out estimate
finder.profile_wording_rule: Profiles are source-derived need statements and must not copy the gold paper title. They are frozen before execution and do not consult rankings.
finder.template_conformance_boundary: Candidate-specific template conformance checks that generated fields name and cite their selected paper; because the template inserts those fields, this is contract evidence rather than independent usefulness or specificity validation.
finder.proxy_boundary: Usefulness and feasibility judgments are AI proxy labels only and are not student, supervisor, or field validation. Null or negative deltas must be retained.

topics.production_projection: descending score, first 8 labels, no evaluation-only threshold
topics.claim_boundary: This small AI-silver, source-derived technical-corpus set contains known-positive labels only. It supports positive-label recall/coverage, not precision, F1, exact match, or public topic/author behavior; predictions outside the listed positives remain unadjudicated rather than false positives.

ocr.claim_boundary: The deterministic raster-only fixture exercises the OCR pipeline. It is not a corpus OCR-accuracy estimate and does not validate scanned TTLAB PDFs.

cluster_units.finder: profile family; sensitivity-only variants excluded from the primary estimate

output_contract.versionable_output_policy: Only structural outputs, IDs, hashes, classifications, aggregate metrics, and bounded author-created case text may enter the canonical artifact directory. Extractive answers, source snippets, generated recommendations, and topic evidence text are excluded.

restricted_raw_output_policy.location: ignored operator-controlled directory outside release artifacts

output_contract.structural_reproduction_comparison: all case-level outputs normalized by excluding timestamp fields only
output_contract.macro_source: deterministic rendering of held-out test metrics after execution

historical_v1.statement: No v1 file is overwritten, upgraded, or relabeled as prospective evidence by this protocol.
